messages:
Clara (marketing): Quick flag 1 1 — HubSpot shows a cluster of unowned signups starting 13:10 CET. `hs_enriched` missing on initial delivery. Anyone else seeing this?
Owen (revops): Yep. Delivery logs show enrich-webhook 502s for batched payloads. Our RR lambda tests enrichment immediately and moves on after 2m.
Pri (ops): Proposed short fix: route leads without `hs_enriched=true` into `rr-fallback` and set property `fallback_reason=enrich_delay`. Also bump claim_window from 120s -> 420s via feature flag for 2h. Thumbs?
Dee (growth): Thumbs. We'll pause webinar automation for the cohort to avoid duplicate nudges. Add cohort tag `enrich-delay-3512467890` so we can measure lift.
Marta (sales-eng): Please add visible HubSpot note "Fallback routed due to enrichment delay" and header `X-Routed-Via: fallback_enrich` on webhooks so downstream tools can filter.
leadflow-bot: alert: enrich-webhook /v1/bulk 5xx rose from 0.2% -> 7.6% (13:05-13:18 CET). Auto-backoff applied.
Pri (ops): Rolling patch: set FF claim_window_seconds=420 (canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% if stable), add router guard `if enriched!=true -> assign rr-fallback and tag`. Canary URL: https://grafana.redwood/d/leadflow/routing?panel=2
Owen (revops): I'll create dashboards for `time_to_owner` and `first_touch_conversion` for cohort tag and set alert if avg time_to_owner > 6m. Opening incident INC-2026-7752.
Clara (marketing): Draft comms to #sales-ops: "Temporary fallback routing active while enrichment recovers. You may see leads with tag `fallback_reason=enrich_delay`. Treat as normal leads; do not duplicate outreach." Approve?
Marta (sales-eng): Approve. Add instruction: "If owner flips, reach out once and note in HS timeline."
Pri (ops): Canary healthy at 13:26 CET, moving to 25%. Enrich 5xx trending down to 2.4%.
leadflow-bot: deploy-bot: feature-flag ff-lead-claim-3512467890 applied by pri.ops (canary).
Dee (growth): After incident, let's A/B claim_window lengths (120s vs 300s vs 420s) to find the best tradeoff for time_to_owner vs duplication.
Owen (revops): Good plan. Postmortem action: make enrich callbacks idempotent, ensure HubSpot retries don't lose metadata, and consider 300s default claim_window. I'll consolidate.
Clara (marketing): Sent rep note and paused webinar sends. Keeping thread updated.
Pri (ops): Final: 100% rollout at 13:39 CET, keeping claim_window=420s for 2h for monitoring.
leadflow-bot: note: incident INC-2026-7752 created and cohort tag applied.
